title: Get Sourcing Working End to End
description: Get sourcing working end to end. Plugin build fails: UiPresence undeclared and UiToggleNode missing pressed field (presence-based UI model) in sourcing/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Fix compile errors and verify sourcing-curate runs via framework OS playground (dev:sourcing).
summary: Fixed sourcing-plugin compile break against the unified UiPresence model (import UiPresence; module filter toggles use presence.selected instead of removed pressed). Verified wasm/OS build, curate+plugin unit tests (incl. new filter-bar presence regression), and Playwright smoke of sourcing-curate on :6081 showing Pool/Curated/Preview/Grid with Beams/Windows/Slabs and no page errors.
